# Iftekhar E Mahbub Zeeon

> Full-stack software engineer at Retune AI Inc in Dhaka, Bangladesh, where he is building re:frame. He previously architected Farmers Card, Bangladesh's national farmer registry, while at Pridesys IT Ltd. B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering from BUET (2024). Author of BTVSL, a Bangla Sign Language dataset published at IEEE FG 2024. Also known as Zeeon or Iftekhar Zeeon.

## About

- [Home](https://iftekharzeeon.github.io/): bio, selected work, experience, projects, research and education
- [Résumé (PDF)](https://iftekharzeeon.github.io/resume.pdf)
- [Education and awards](https://iftekharzeeon.github.io/education/): BUET, Notre Dame College, Government Laboratory High School; BASIS National ICT Award 2020 winner
- [What he is doing now](https://iftekharzeeon.github.io/now/)

## Case studies

- [From manual spreadsheets to a scalable fund platform](https://iftekharzeeon.github.io/work/vipb-fund-accounting/): VIPB Asset Management, sole developer, customer and admin portals, 6 mutual funds moved off Excel
- [Farmers Card, a national farmer registry](https://iftekharzeeon.github.io/work/farmers-card-database/): architect, 2.5M+ farmers, 4 mobile apps, Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes
- [Rebuilding a 7,143-screen ERP by replaying its history](https://iftekharzeeon.github.io/work/pridesys-erp-rebuild/): Pridesys ERP, Oracle to PostgreSQL, React and Spring Boot
- [AI products, and a production rescue](https://iftekharzeeon.github.io/work/retune-ai-products/): Retune AI, re:frame, retune.so hybrid search, awaken.is

## Research

- [BTVSL: A Novel Sentence-Level Annotated Dataset for Bangla Sign Language Translation](https://iftekharzeeon.github.io/research/): IEEE FG 2024, DOI 10.1109/FG59268.2024.10581873
